name: Nonohara Hiroyuki
source: Mikako's husband and Makoto's father who has been trying to gain money to pay for the debt in order to release his family from the villainous Marie's clutches. [spoiler]However, he has run out of time to do so and plans to murder Marie which is foiled by Marisa. Having no use for him further, Marie proceeds to murder him at the party[/spoiler]
